summary: Iteration 9 retest of the 5 fixes from iteration 8. All 5 pass. FIX 1: the first page of the Blå filter is all solid blue (Mörk marinblå/Marinblå/Kornblå), with no 'Svart' or grey. Colour scores never go up across pages 1-3. The first page of the Svart filter is all solid 'Svart'. In the UI, Färg=Blå shows 669 articles. The first cards show navy images labelled 'Mörk marinblå'/'Marinblå'/'Kornblå'. Tapping a card opens /product/14631344?color=8600 with the 8600 tile active, FÄRG reading Mörk marinblå and the same image as the card. FIX 2: notification-bell is visible on gender-picker (44x44) and opens /notifications. Going back returns to the picker. FIX 3: checked by code review and a source test. After the email fails, the code goes on to the admin notify loop, and the title ends with ' (mejlet kunde inte skickas)'. FIX 4: unread equals the DB count_documents result. With 105 extra unread notifications seeded, items capped at 100 and unread was 105 or more. The test data was removed afterwards. FIX 5: the timeline testIDs are unique, e.g. timeline-step-skickad-0, -bekräftad-1, -nekad-2. Backend tests: 7/7 pass. No orders placed, no emails sent, no catalog sync. No deprecated Expo packages detected.
action_items: Optional/minor: the 'pending' timeline step label 'Väntar på bekräftelse' gives a testID with spaces (timeline-step-väntar på bekräftelse-N). Consider using s.key instead of the label in the testID.

Backend $switch scoring (server.py:477-481) and src/color-match.ts pickColor use the same scores (3/2/1/0), so the list ranking and the card/PDP colour agree.
